models.name: discussion_board_platform_configs
models.description: Platform-wide configuration metadata for the discussionBoard service. Used for storing system-wide settings, feature flags, and versioned configurations. This table supports reference by all domain tables but is never referenced itself. Rich description field supports documentation and policy linkage. Designed for auditability and administrative traceability.

plainFields.name: config_name
plainFields.description: Unique system-wide configuration key name. Defines the purpose or area of the config, e.g. 'feature_toggle', 'site_name', etc.

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: Configuration value stored as text, interpreted by the platform according to the config type. Can be JSON-encoded or primitive as needed.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of the configuration's intent, affected areas, and usage constraints. Useful for maintainers and auditors.

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Whether this configuration is currently active in the system. Supports quick disabling/enabling of features or settings platform-wide.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Version number for this config entry, incremented on each update for auditability and rollback support.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration entry was soft-deleted (if applicable). Null if active.

models.name: discussion_board_categories
models.description: Hierarchical and dynamic topic classification master table. Each row represents a configurable category for posts or comments, with optional nesting via parent_id. Used by various content tables for topic classification and filtering. Category data is editable only by admins, and all changes are versioned via incremented 'version' field. The model supports soft deletion and reordering.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Self-reference for parent category's {@link discussion_board_categories.id}. Used to construct category hierarchies. Nullable for root categories.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Unique, human-readable category name as shown in UI and used for filtering or search.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional extended description of the category, for admin and UI tooltip use.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Integer value for sorting categories in the UI. Lower values appear first; can be recalibrated by admins.

plainFields.name: icon_uri
plainFields.description: URI to the representative icon for this category, used in front-end navigation or list displays.

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Whether this category is displayed to end users and available for new content assignment.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Incrementing version for tracking category changes and enabling audit trails or rollback.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp the category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp the category was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was deactivated or scheduled for removal. Null if currently active.

models.name: discussion_board_policy_documents
models.description: Master table for storing policy documents, terms of use, and community operational rules. Each record represents a single document (or version thereof), and all policy changes are versioned for auditability. Used for referencing within the application UI, linking to compliance, and tracking user or admin acceptance. Document text is stored as full-text for legal and search purposes; snapshot versioning allows robust audit logs.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Document title, e.g. 'Terms of Service', 'Content Guidelines', etc. Unique for each simultaneously active version.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Complete body text of the policy document, markdown or HTML-encoded. Full-text search supported for legal discovery or compliance audit.

plainFields.name: version
plainFields.description: Monotonic version number. Increments on every edit. Enables showing current vs historical policy and supporting rollback/auditability.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this policy document version is currently in force and visible to users. Multiple versions can exist; only one per (title) should be active at a time.

plainFields.name: created_by_admin_id
plainFields.description: Admin's {@link discussion_board_admins.id} who authored, approved, or updated this policy document.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Document creation datetime.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification datetime of the policy document.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Datetime when this policy document was rendered obsolete or deleted. Null if still current.

models.name: discussion_board_guests
models.description: Non-member (guest) user tracking table. Records session or visitor tokens for users accessing the discussion board without an account. Used for analytics or tracking potential abuse, not for persistent identity. Typically contains only anonymous access-related information (e.g., session tracking, legal policy audit logs). No foreign keys to other user tables. No business fields that could identify a person are allowed. Only operational metadata and temporal fields are included.

plainFields.name: session_token
plainFields.description: Anonymous guest session tracking token. Used to group activities from the same device/browser during the same access period. Not personally identifying.

plainFields.name: last_seen_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of guest's last activity. Used for analytics and session expiration.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: The IP address associated with the guest session for abuse monitoring and operational analytics. Not for personal identification.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string of the guest's browser/device, logged for audit and abuse prevention.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest record was last updated. For auditing session changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session tracking was soft-deleted, if applicable.

models.name: discussion_board_members
models.description: Discussion board regular member accounts. Stores essential identifying and contact information for registered users authenticated via email or social login. Includes profile management, core authentication (hashed password for local accounts), email verification status, and role flags. No foreign keys to other user role tables. All sensitive and personal data adheres to legal privacy requirements. Audit trails ensured via metadata fields.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Member's unique email address, the main login/account identifier. Required for all members. Used for notification and password resets.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Whether the member's email has been verified for login and access elevation.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of the member's password, present only for local authentication (not needed for external OAuth-only members).

plainFields.name: nickname
plainFields.description: Display nickname for the member within the community. Unique within the system.

plainFields.name: avatar_uri
plainFields.description: URI to the member's avatar image. Optional; defaults to system image if not set.

plainFields.name: joined_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of member's registration completion.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last successful login for this member.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status: e.g., 'active', 'suspended', 'pending_verification', 'withdrawn'. String code, not enum, to allow for extensibility; enforced by application/business logic.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member record was created (audit trail).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this member (profile/account info changes).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, set when the member requests account withdrawal or is de-provisioned.

models.name: discussion_board_moderators
models.description: Moderator role accounts for the discussion board. Moderators manage content quality and enforce policy, with permissions above standard members but below admins. May be promoted from members, but are tracked separately here for audit and policy isolation. Includes information on assignment and demotion periods. Only stores moderator-specific data. Identity/authorization cross-referencing is via email (matched to members) but foreign keys are not enforced to prevent privilege escalation by join. Role change and status transitions are managed via business logic.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Moderator's email. Used for correspondence and matching to member accounts. Not a foreign key for strict separation of privilege.

plainFields.name: assigned_by_admin_email
plainFields.description: Email of the admin who assigned the moderator role; for administrative accountability and audit trail.

plainFields.name: assigned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderator assignment was granted.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when moderator rights were revoked, null if currently active.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Moderator account status: e.g., 'active', 'revoked', 'suspended'. Business logic enforces allowed values.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the moderator record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this moderator assignment.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for moderator record lifecycle management.

models.name: discussion_board_admins
models.description: Discussion board administrator accounts, representing the highest privilege level in the system. Store critical admin identity and assignment lifecycle details for policy governance and incident response. No foreign keys to prevent privilege escalation. Assignment and revocation are tracked with audit fields. All security-sensitive operations logged elsewhere, but core admin info must be immutable and auditable. Emails are used for login and communication, must be unique.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator's unique email address for login and communication.

plainFields.name: assigned_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin role was assigned to this account. Used for privilege lifetime tracking.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this admin role was revoked, or null if active.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status: e.g., 'active', 'revoked', 'suspended'. Policy and lifecycle management uses this field.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin record was created (for auditability).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to this admin record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for lifecycle management.

models.name: discussion_board_posts
models.description: Represents all main forum posts in the discussion board. Each post is authored by either a member, moderator, or admin (referenced via foreign keys to those user tables) and is optionally linked to a discussion_board_category and platform configuration. This table stores only raw content (title, body, attachment link(s)), category assignment, and status. No voting, comment, or moderation data is included here, which are managed by other components. Includes temporal fields for full audit (creation, update, soft deletion) and supports future extension for post versioning and snapshot. Complies with 3NF, with no denormalized/cached vote or comment counts.

foreignFields.name: author_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}. Used when post author is a regular member.

foreignFields.name: author_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged moderator's {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}. Used when post author is a moderator.

foreignFields.name: author_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged admin's {@link discussion_board_admins.id}. Used when post author is an administrator.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Assigned post's category (optional). References {@link discussion_board_categories.id}.

foreignFields.name: platform_config_id
foreignFields.description: Platform configuration for post context (multi-instance/segmentation support). References {@link discussion_board_platform_configs.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Post title. Maximum 100 characters. Required on all posts.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main post content/body. Maximum 4000 characters. Required field.

plainFields.name: attachments
plainFields.description: Optional URI-encoded or JSON string listing post attachments (cloud link, images, files, etc.). Up to 5 attachments allowed per post.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Post status code: e.g., 'active', 'deleted', 'hidden', 'flagged'. Exact codes managed by business rules. Used for workflow visibility and moderation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Post creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Post last update timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Post deletion timestamp (null if not deleted; soft delete logic).

models.name: discussion_board_comments
models.description: Stores all comments (including replies) linked to discussion board posts. Each comment is authored by either a member, moderator, or admin (referenced via foreign keys to user tables). Parent-child relationships are supported through the thread_parent_comment_id field to allow for hierarchical reply trees (single parent per comment; top-level comments have null parent). Every comment references its source post. Content, visibility status, and temporal/audit columns are included. No cached vote or report data is present in this table. Strict normalization: only raw comment data and relationships are stored. Entity includes fields for full temporal audit and soft delete. 3NF enforced; all denormalization is prohibited except in mv_ prefixed views.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: The post associated with this comment. {@link discussion_board_posts.id}.

foreignFields.name: author_member_id
foreignFields.description: Comment author's member reference if the author is a regular member. {@link discussion_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: author_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Comment author's moderator reference (when a moderator authors; otherwise null). {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}.

foreignFields.name: author_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Comment author's admin reference (when an admin authors the comment; otherwise null). {@link discussion_board_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: thread_parent_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Self-referencing: parent comment's {@link discussion_board_comments.id}. Null if this is a top-level comment.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment content/body text. Maximum 1000 characters. Required for all comments (including replies).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current comment status: e.g., 'active', 'deleted', 'hidden', 'flagged'. Statuses follow business workflow.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when comment was written (UTC, required).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Comment last updated timestamp (UTC, required).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete field: timestamp of deletion, or null if not deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_post_votes
models.description: Stores the record of each upvote or downvote by a member on an individual post in the discussion board. Ensures that every voting interaction is traceable, and a member may only vote once per post. Used for calculating post popularity, abuse/fraud detection, and detailed interaction analytics. Foreign keys link to the member (discussion_board_members) and the target post (discussion_board_posts). All votes are auditable with full temporal fields.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link discussion_board_posts.id} for which the vote is cast.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Voter's {@link discussion_board_members.id} who cast the vote.

plainFields.name: is_upvote
plainFields.description: Whether the vote is an upvote (true) or a downvote (false).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this vote was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this vote was last updated (e.g., for audit/toggling).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the vote interaction (null if active, set when deleted).

models.name: discussion_board_comment_votes
models.description: Stores the record of each upvote or downvote by a member on an individual comment in the discussion board. Each record ensures that a member can only vote once per comment. Used for calculating comment engagement, community trust signals, and moderation/abuse detection. Links to the member (discussion_board_members) and the comment (discussion_board_comments). Auditable with full temporal fields for forensics and analytics.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link discussion_board_comments.id} for which the vote is cast.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Voter's {@link discussion_board_members.id} who cast the vote.

plainFields.name: is_upvote
plainFields.description: Whether the vote is an upvote (true) or a downvote (false).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this vote was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this vote was last updated (e.g., for audit/toggling).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the vote interaction (null if active, set when deleted).

models.name: discussion_board_post_reports
models.description: Logs each abuse report submitted against a discussion board post. Stores reporting user, post information, reason, type, status, handler, result, and freeform message for audit and moderation. Enables tracking report lifecycle from submission through resolution for all reported posts. Relates to {@link discussion_board_posts}, {@link discussion_board_members}, and moderation staff tables.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post that is being reported. {@link discussion_board_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reporting user who submitted the report. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: handler_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin or moderator who processed the report (if applicable). {@link discussion_board_admins.id}

plainFields.name: reason_type
plainFields.description: Coded reason for report (ex: spam, hate, personal info). Used for policy/statistics.

plainFields.name: reason_text
plainFields.description: Freeform detailed explanation of the report by the user.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current state of this report: 'pending', 'in_review', 'action_taken', 'rejected', etc.

plainFields.name: resolution_message
plainFields.description: Moderator/admin's decision or notes after review. Shown to related parties as needed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time this report record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (including status or handler change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete time (null unless deleted). For data retention & audit.

models.name: discussion_board_comment_reports
models.description: Logs each abuse report submitted against a specific comment. Stores reporter, target comment, reason, type, status, handler, result, freeform message for complete lifecycle audit. Enables tracking each reported comment's review status and moderator actions. Relates to {@link discussion_board_comments}, {@link discussion_board_members}, and moderation staff tables.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment being reported. {@link discussion_board_comments.id}

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reporting user who submitted the report. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: handler_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin or moderator who reviewed this report (if any). {@link discussion_board_admins.id}

plainFields.name: reason_type
plainFields.description: Coded reason for report (ex: spam, hate, personal info). For stats/policy classification.

plainFields.name: reason_text
plainFields.description: Freeform explanation of the report, provided by reporter.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current report status: 'pending', 'in_review', 'action_taken', 'rejected', etc.

plainFields.name: resolution_message
plainFields.description: Moderator/admin's notes or action message, shown to relevant users as needed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time this report record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for status or handler change.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete time (null unless deleted). Used for audit and regulatory compliance.

models.name: discussion_board_user_sanctions
models.description: Tracks all sanctions, bans, or disciplinary actions given to users for rules violations. Records offender, sanctioning admin/moderator, type/level of penalty, reason, timeline, and notes. Each entry supports full audit for compliance, analytics, and legal requirement. Relates to {@link discussion_board_members}, {@link discussion_board_admins}.

foreignFields.name: sanctioned_member_id
foreignFields.description: User receiving this sanction (offender). {@link discussion_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: sanctioning_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin/moderator who issued the sanction. {@link discussion_board_admins.id}

plainFields.name: sanction_type
plainFields.description: Sanction category code, such as 'warning', 'temporary_ban', 'permanent_ban', or 'content_removal'.

plainFields.name: sanction_level
plainFields.description: Business code for severity/level (examples: 'minor', 'moderate', 'severe').

plainFields.name: reason_type
plainFields.description: Policy code for why this sanction is imposed (like 'hate', 'harassment', 'spam').

plainFields.name: reason_text
plainFields.description: Moderator/admin notes and justification in freeform text.

plainFields.name: timeline_start
plainFields.description: Sanction effective start time (UTC).

plainFields.name: timeline_end
plainFields.description: Sanction scheduled end time (null for permanent sanctions).

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the sanction is currently in effect. Used for runtime permission checks and automation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the sanction record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time of last update (status, end date, etc).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker (null unless deleted for audit).

models.name: discussion_board_notifications
models.description: Stores all notification events delivered to users for any workflow event in the system, including post/comment activity, sanctions, reports, moderation actions, or admin messages. Supports scalable, robust notification delivery to different user types (member, moderator, admin, guest if relevant). Ensures reliable, auditable delivery and user UX features like unread/read state, event linkage, and retention for compliance. Has foreign keys to relevant user tables depending on notification recipient type (using one Recipient ForeignKey per role; nullable for multi-type support), and supports linking to event entities (posts/comments/etc) in other domains by uuid reference only (no direct joins, preserving decoupling).

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Notified member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}. Null if not a member notification.

foreignFields.name: moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Notified moderator's {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}. Null if not a moderator notification.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Notified admin's {@link discussion_board_admins.id}. Null if not an admin notification.

foreignFields.name: guest_id
foreignFields.description: Notified guest's {@link discussion_board_guests.id}. Null if not a guest notification.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Notification title (localized for display). Required, typically under 100 characters for UI clarity.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Notification message content, including brief context or instruction. May be plain or rich-text, up to 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Business event type or workflow identifier for notification routing and category. E.g., 'post_comment', 'sanction', 'report_resolved', 'admin_announcement'.

plainFields.name: related_entity_id
plainFields.description: Event's primary entity id (e.g., post id, comment id) for routing and deep-linking. Not a foreign key, avoids tight coupling to other domains. Nullable if generic notification.

plainFields.name: related_entity_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of the entity this notification relates to, e.g. 'post', 'comment', 'report', 'system'. Used with related_entity_id for cross-entity notification routing.

plainFields.name: unread
plainFields.description: Whether the notification has not yet been marked as read by the user. Defaults to true (false when opened/read).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (notification generated/delivered).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (e.g., status/metadata change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention/audit, null if not deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_permission_matrices
models.description: Stores normalized permission mappings for each role in the platform, supporting granular and policy-driven access control. Enables versioned changes to the permissions matrix, maintains audit fields for compliance, and supports soft deletion. Links internally to actor roles via string fields; referential integrity to user tables is managed through rule logs, not directly here.

plainFields.name: role_name
plainFields.description: Unique name of the system role this permission set applies to. Example: 'member', 'moderator', 'admin'.

plainFields.name: resource
plainFields.description: The resource this permission applies to (e.g., 'post', 'comment', 'report', 'category', 'policy').

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: The permitted action for this role over the resource. Example: 'read', 'write', 'delete', 'approve', 'review'.

plainFields.name: allowed
plainFields.description: Whether this action is allowed (true) or disallowed/denied (false) for this role-resource combination. Used for both allowlist and denylist patterns.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Start datetime when this permission entry becomes effective (for versioning/time-based policy enforcement).

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: Datetime when this permission entry ceases to be effective (null if currently valid).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time for audit tracking.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if this matrix record is logically deleted.

models.name: discussion_board_rule_logs
models.description: Implements a complete versioned audit log for all rules and policy changes applied to the discussion board system. Captures rule type, full text, change type (created, modified, retired), and the operative system actor (by role and optional reference to a specific admin/member). Ensures roll-back, review, and compliance for all regulatory and internal policy needs. Designed for immutability once inserted, and includes full audit and soft-delete fields.

foreignFields.name: operator_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin user who enacted this rule change. References {@link discussion_board_admins.id}. May be null if operated by other role types.

foreignFields.name: operator_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member user who enacted this rule change. References {@link discussion_board_members.id}. May be null if operated by admin only or by system actor.

plainFields.name: rule_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of rule being logged. Example: 'permission_matrix', 'sanction_policy', 'category', 'general_policy'.

plainFields.name: rule_text
plainFields.description: Full text of the rule or policy document at the time of this change (snapshot for review/compliance).

plainFields.name: change_type
plainFields.description: Type of change for the audit trail: expected values 'created', 'modified', 'retired', 'imported', 'rolled_back'.

plainFields.name: change_description
plainFields.description: Brief description of what was changed and why (reason for rule modification).

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: Datetime when this rule entry becomes effective.

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: Datetime when this rule entry ceases to be effective (null if rule is currently active).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Audit field: time the rule log entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Audit field: time the rule log entry was last updated (should not change after initial write, but present for schema hygiene).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion field if rule log is deleted for legal or compliance reasons (rarely used).

models.name: discussion_board_external_auth_logs
models.description: Logs for all external authentication attempts (social login, OAuth2, email verification, etc.) capturing channel, external_user_id, subject email, key timestamps, and outcome. References discussion_board_members and related tables for identification. Provides audit trail for authentication-related issues and compliance tracing.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}. Null if not mapped to a member.

plainFields.name: auth_channel
plainFields.description: External authentication channel (e.g., 'kakao', 'naver', 'google', 'email', etc.).

plainFields.name: external_user_id
plainFields.description: Unique user identifier received from the external provider, if applicable.

plainFields.name: subject_email
plainFields.description: Email address used in the authentication attempt (may differ from account email).

plainFields.name: issued_at
plainFields.description: Datetime at which the external auth event was initiated.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: Datetime at which external auth flow was completed (success/fail).

plainFields.name: success
plainFields.description: Whether the authentication attempt succeeded.

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: Error code from external system or local process (if any).

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Detailed error message or trouble context (if any).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the log entry.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the log entry.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete marker for the log entry.

models.name: discussion_board_email_logs
models.description: Logs all outgoing emails sent by the system (e.g. verification, password reset, notifications). Tracks SMTP status, recipient, purpose, response data and integrations with external mail APIs. Used for compliance and troubleshooting outgoing communications.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member for whom the email was sent. {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: recipient_email
plainFields.description: Target recipient's email address.

plainFields.name: email_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of email (e.g., verification, password_reset, notification).

plainFields.name: subject
plainFields.description: Email subject line.

plainFields.name: sent_at
plainFields.description: Datetime email was sent (handed to mail server).

plainFields.name: delivery_status
plainFields.description: Status reported by the SMTP/mail provider (e.g., SENT, DELIVERED, FAILED).

plainFields.name: response_code
plainFields.description: SMTP or service provider response code (if available).

plainFields.name: response_message
plainFields.description: Provider's response message or delivery/trouble note.

plainFields.name: external_message_id
plainFields.description: External provider's assigned message ID for traceability (if any).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the log entry.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the log entry.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete marker for the log entry.

models.name: discussion_board_ad_integration_logs
models.description: Logs for external ad/analytics integrations related to user activity and ad serving, supporting audit/compliance of third-party advertising or analytics data flows. Includes channel, event, response, and mapping to local events/users where allowed.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the member associated with the ad/analytic event (if any). {@link discussion_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: ad_channel
plainFields.description: Ad/analytics platform channel (e.g., 'google_adsense', 'naver_ad', 'ga4', etc.).

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type of ad/analytics event (e.g., impression, click, conversion, error, etc.).

plainFields.name: external_event_id
plainFields.description: Unique event ID as received from the external ad/analytics system, if any.

plainFields.name: local_event_context
plainFields.description: Context or description of the mapped local event (post viewed, ad clicked, page scrolled, etc.).

plainFields.name: event_at
plainFields.description: Datetime the ad/analytics event occurred or was logged by the system.

plainFields.name: success
plainFields.description: Whether the integration event was considered successful (versus error/fail).

plainFields.name: response_payload
plainFields.description: Raw response or request payload from ad/analytics provider (as string, often JSON).

plainFields.name: error_code
plainFields.description: External system or integration error code, if any.

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: Error/debug/troubleshooting context (if any).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the log entry.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the log entry.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete marker for the log entry.

models.name: discussion_board_operation_logs
models.description: Records all privileged actions and high-impact changes within the discussionBoard platform (e.g., admin or moderator system actions, sensitive config edits, security events, high-importance manual interventions). Designed for immutable audit trailing, regulatory compliance, and forensic capability. References the user (admin, moderator, or member) who performed the action. Optionally links to the affected resource or target entity by UUID, without duplicating business data. Included fields support real-time and historical filtering of actions by actor, action type, resource, and time window.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Acting administrator's {@link discussion_board_admins.id}. Used when the operation was performed by an admin.

foreignFields.name: actor_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Acting moderator's {@link discussion_board_moderators.id}. Used when the operation was performed by a moderator.

foreignFields.name: actor_member_id
foreignFields.description: Acting member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}, when a regular member triggers a log-worthy action (rare).

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of privileged operation or system action (e.g., 'user_sanction','policy_change','critical_config_edit','escalation','audit_view','manual_patch').

plainFields.name: resource_table
plainFields.description: Name of target resource table for the action (e.g., 'discussion_board_posts','discussion_board_policy_documents'). Allows generic linking to affected row, supporting polymorphism.

plainFields.name: resource_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the target resource row affected by this action, if any. Nullable to support system-wide actions with no single row target.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address (IPv4/IPv6) from which the operation originated. Used for compliance and forensic research.

plainFields.name: ua_string
plainFields.description: User agent or system identifier string for context (typically browser/OS or automation agent info).

plainFields.name: action_details
plainFields.description: Structured details or JSON (as string) containing the input payload, parameters, or contextual meta for the privileged action. For audit and forensic purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of log creation (UTC). Marks when the operation occurred.

models.name: discussion_board_policy_change_logs
models.description: Captures every administrative policy/config change in the discussionBoard system for legal and regulatory compliance. Stores before/after values, the specific policy/config target, actor, and justification. Ensures any change to governance, user rights, moderation, workflow, or audit policy is non-negotiably logged. Supports future audits, rollbacks, and incident investigations. Linked to the responsible admin and optionally references the previous policy revision.

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator responsible for the policy change. References {@link discussion_board_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: previous_policy_change_id
foreignFields.description: Optional self-reference to previous version of this policy change log (for policy versioning/history). References {@link discussion_board_policy_change_logs.id}.

plainFields.name: policy_namespace
plainFields.description: Domain or subsystem of the policy/configuration (e.g., 'reporting','moderation','user_signup','permission_matrix'). Used for high-level filtering and classification.

plainFields.name: target_table
plainFields.description: Table name of the affected policy/config. Supports structured audit trails for adjustable policies.

plainFields.name: target_field
plainFields.description: Column or config key within the table/config that was changed.

plainFields.name: previous_value
plainFields.description: Serialized previous value (stringified or JSON as string) before the change, for rollback/audit.

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: Serialized new value (stringified or JSON as string) after the change.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Justification, risk assessment, or change ticket/ISSUE reference for the policy update.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the policy change was performed and this log created.

models.name: discussion_board_post_metrics
models.description: Stores per-post analytics and performance counters, enabling trend tracking, operational dashboarding, and business KPI reporting for the discussion board. Each record reflects metrics for a single post and references the corresponding business post via a foreign key. Includes cumulative counters and snapshot efficiency data. Closely related models include {@link discussion_board_posts} (post entity reference) and dashboard aggregations.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Related post's {@link discussion_board_posts.id}. Establishes which post these metrics correspond to.

plainFields.name: views_count
plainFields.description: Total number of times this post has been viewed. Used for popularity and reach analytics.

plainFields.name: comments_count
plainFields.description: Total number of comments on this post. Useful for engagement and discussion quality analysis.

plainFields.name: votes_up_count
plainFields.description: Total number of upvotes (recommendations) for this post. Measures positive community feedback.

plainFields.name: votes_down_count
plainFields.description: Total number of downvotes for this post. Indicates negative feedback or disagreement.

plainFields.name: reports_count
plainFields.description: Total number of reports (complaints) filed against this post. Used for monitoring community safety and moderation activity.

plainFields.name: last_activity_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent post-related activity (such as comment or vote). Aids in staleness/recency analytics.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Metric record creation timestamp (not the post's creation). Used for time series analysis of metric introduction.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last time the metrics for this post were updated or recalculated.

models.name: discussion_board_user_metrics
models.description: Aggregated user-level discussion board analytics, tracking each member's participation, reputation, and engagement trends. Useful for leaderboards, gamification, operational dashboards, and behavioral monitoring. References a member via a foreign key; all fields represent denormalized/cached counters for OLAP/reporting only (not transactional logic). Related entity: {@link discussion_board_members}.

foreignFields.name: discussion_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: User/member's {@link discussion_board_members.id}. Indicates which user's metrics are being tracked.

plainFields.name: posts_count
plainFields.description: Total number of posts created by the user. For gamification, leaderboard, and activity scoring.

plainFields.name: comments_count
plainFields.description: Total number of comments made by the user. Supports evaluation of engagement and contribution volume.

plainFields.name: votes_up_given_count
plainFields.description: Cumulative count of upvotes the user has cast (on posts/comments). Measures positive engagement impact.

plainFields.name: votes_down_given_count
plainFields.description: Cumulative count of downvotes given by the user. Tracks critical/judgemental participation.

plainFields.name: reports_made_count
plainFields.description: How many reports/complaints the user has filed. Supports abuse/oversight detection and moderation review.

plainFields.name: reputation_score
plainFields.description: User's computed reputation score, derived from post quality, votes, moderation status, etc. Reflects overall standing in the community.

plainFields.name: last_activity_at
plainFields.description: Last activity of the user (e.g., post, comment, vote). Useful for staleness detection, churn analysis, and award automation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this metric record was created (not the user's signup date). Used for metric evolution tracking.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last metric update for this user (not profile update). Supports scheduled batch recalculations.

models.name: discussion_board_daily_stats
models.description: Holds daily OLAP/cube-style aggregates for the discussion board (posts, comments, votes, reports, user signups, traffic, etc.) for business monitoring and executive reporting. Each record represents a single UTC date. Supports year-on-year/trend analytics, peak analysis, and real-time dashboarding. Not directly tied to a business entity, but cross-references multiple domains for time-based comparison.

plainFields.name: date_utc
plainFields.description: The UTC date (at midnight) for which all metrics in this record are aggregated. Used as the partition key for trending, comparison, and calendar OLAP.

plainFields.name: posts_count
plainFields.description: Number of new posts created on this calendar date. Used for engagement/traffic KPIs.

plainFields.name: comments_count
plainFields.description: Number of new comments created on this date. Tracks community interaction trends.

plainFields.name: votes_up_count
plainFields.description: Aggregate upvotes made across all posts and comments during the day. Measures positive activity trends.

plainFields.name: votes_down_count
plainFields.description: Aggregate downvotes made for all content types on this date. Tracks negative feedback.

plainFields.name: reports_count
plainFields.description: Total number of reports (posts/comments) filed for possible policy violation on this date.

plainFields.name: new_user_signups_count
plainFields.description: Number of new users registered on this date. For conversion and onboarding rate analytics.

plainFields.name: active_users_count
plainFields.description: Unique users who actively contributed (post/comment/vote) during the day. Vital for DAU/MAU and churn trends.

plainFields.name: traffic_sessions_count
plainFields.description: Total sessions (visits) recorded for the site/service on this date. Includes both members and guests. Foundation for traffic analytics/KPIs.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp (when this daily stat was first stored).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last batch/statistics update for this day.
